newsitem.title: USA: NYSE Oct 7-11 program trading averages 8.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: NYSE Oct 7-11 program trading averages 8.3 percent.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said program trading averaged 8.3 percent of its average daily volume of 403.0 million shares, or 33.4 million shares a day, for the week of October 7-11.
Program trading accounted for an average of 10.4 percent of average daily volume of 420.7 million shares for the week of September 30 to October 4.
Of the average 33.4 million shares during the week, buy programs accounted for an average 18.5 million shares, while sell programs accounted for an average 14.9 million daily.
